mapper.insert: INSERT INTO courses (teacher_id, student_id, academic_year) VALUES (#{teacherId}, #{studentId}, #{academicYear})
mapper.sql: SELECT c.id AS course_id, c.academic_year, c.teacher_id, t.username AS teacher_username, t.name AS teacher_name, t.city AS teacher_city, t.telegram AS teacher_telegram, t.vk AS teacher_vk, u.id AS student_id, u.username, u.name, u.city, u.telegram, u.vk, u.grade FROM courses c JOIN users u ON u.id = c.student_id JOIN users t ON t.id = c.teacher_id
mapper.select: ORDER BY COALESCE(u.name, u.username) COLLATE NOCASE
